pros: Comprehensive features for project management and business process automation.
Centralized platform for task tracking, deadlines, and team workload visibility.
Customization options, though sometimes lacking guardrails for best practices.
cons: Steep learning curve due to the sheer number of features.
Occasional performance issues or lag, particularly with the mobile app.
Interface can feel overwhelming or cluttered at times, with default elements sometimes obscuring content.
